crop.notes: Whole 'Sporting Notes' column; the Allen notice is the first three-line item, followed by unrelated football and racing items.

ocr.notes: Allen notice transcribed correctly; 'Charles Durphy' is read as 'Dorney'.

summary.suggested: A notice under "Sporting Notes" in the St. Louis Globe-Democrat advertised Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, with a free concert every evening and only the very best talent engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, November 28, 1896, page 4.

facts.fact: Allen's saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertised a free concert every evening ("very best of talent only engaged"); he styled himself retired champion pugilist of the world

notes: Standing saloon notice. Focus primary because the item is entirely about Allen, though only three lines.
